title: A simplified method for generating human inner ear organoids from pluripotent stem cells
protocol: Aspirate spent medium of the cells in one well of a 6-well culture plate.
Wash cells with 2.5 ml of 1X DPBS twice, and aspirate the DPBS from the last wash.
Add 500 μl of Accutase to the well and incubate for 3-4 minutes at 37°C in a CO2 incubator.
Shake the plate horizontally after 3 minutes of incubation.
Check under a microscope to confirm that the cells are detached; if not fully detached, incubate extra 20 seconds to 1 minute until all cells are loose and partially single-celled.
Using a 5 ml serological pipette, aliquot 5 ml of E8-10Y into a sterile 15 ml tube.
Using a 5 ml serological pipette, gently pipette up-and-down to break up cell clusters into single cells in the well where cells were detached by Accutase treatment.
Collect all cell suspension back into the tube with a final volume of 5.5 ml.
Centrifuge for 5 minutes and 30 seconds at 230 rcf at room temperature to pellet cells.
Carefully remove the supernatant by aspiration without disturbing the cell pellet.
Tilt the tube to flow the medium away from the pellet for aspiration.
Resuspend cells in 1 ml of E8-10Y by gently pipetting up and down using a p1000 tip.
Forcefully pipette 1 ml of E8-10Y medium through the cell strainer mesh to equilibrate it.
Pipette resuspended cells in E8-10Y onto the cell strainer drop-wise.
Rinse the conical tube with 1 ml of E8-10Y medium and pipette onto the cell strainer drop-wise to thoroughly collect cells.
Carefully remove and discard the cell strainer snap cap.
Prepare 50 μl of Trypan blue in a 500 μl tube.
Pipette up and down the cell suspension in the test tube to mix evenly using a p1000 tip.
Collect 50 μl of cell suspension from the center of the test tube.
Transfer the collected cell suspension into 50 μl of Trypan blue to create a 1:1 dilution.
Pipette up-and-down to mix cells with trypan blue evenly.
Add 11 μl of Cell:Trypan blue mixture into both sides of the counting chamber slide for Invitrogen Countess II automated counter or hemocytometer.
Calculate the number of cells, considering the 1:1 dilution factor.
Determine the volume of cell suspension needed to achieve a final concentration of 35,000 cells/ml in 22 ml of E8-20Y medium.
Remove the calculated volume of E8-20Y medium from the prepared solution.
Add the required volume of cell suspension to the remaining E8-20Y medium.
Remove 1.54 ml of E8-20Y from the culture medium and discard.
Add 1.54 ml of cell suspension into the remaining 20.46 ml of E8-20Y medium.
Invert several times or swirl the tube to mix the cell suspension evenly.
Pour the 22 ml cell suspension into a 25 ml reservoir.
Using a multi-channel pipette, aliquot 100 μl of cell suspension into each of 96-well U-bottom plates.
Spin down the plates at 110 rcf for 6 min at room temperature.
Incubate the plates in a 37°C incubator with 5.0% CO2 for 24 hours.
Pour 22 ml of fresh E8 medium into a 25 ml reservoir.
Using a multichannel pipette, add 100 μl of E8 medium into each well, bringing the total volume to 200 μl per well.
Incubate the plates in the 37°C incubator with 5.0% CO2 for 24 hours.
Thaw 600 μl of Matrigel on ice overnight at 4°C.
Prepare 30 ml of E6 medium containing 60 μl of Normocin and keep on ice.
Remove 600 μl of E6 medium prepared above.
Add 600 μl of Matrigel to the removed E6 medium.
Add 30 μl of SB, 0.6 μl of FGF, and 0.75 μl of BMP4 to the mixture.
Invert several times to mix evenly and keep on ice.
Prepare 3 ml of E6 medium in a 15 ml falcon tube for washing step.
Collect all aggregates from 96-well U-bottom plates into a 2 ml round-bottom tube.
Using W-O p200 tips and a multi-channel pipette, collect approximately 30 μl less than the total volume in each well of aggregates on a 100 mm petri-dish.
Gently swirl the petri-dish to concentrate all aggregates into the center of the dish.
Collect all concentrated aggregates using a W-O p1000 tip and transfer them into a 2 ml round-bottom tube.
Carefully remove excessive E8 medium from the tube.
Wash with 1 ml of E6 medium for three times to completely remove traces of E8 medium.
Add 1 ml of E6SFB medium to the tube containing aggregates.
Place a new 100 mm petri-dish on ice and add ~15 ml of E6SFB medium prepared ahead.
Transfer all aggregates, including 1 ml of E6SFB, to the petri-dish containing 15 ml of E6SFB on ice using a W-O p1000 tip.
Use extra 1 ml of E6SFB medium to collect and transfer any remaining aggregates in the tube to the petri-dish.
Transfer individual aggregate in 100 μl of E6SFB medium into each well in a new 96-well U-bottom plate using a W-O p200 tip.
Incubate in 37°C incubator with 5.0% CO2.
Observe morphological changes every day.
Make E6 medium containing 1 μM LDN and 250 ng/ml FGF – hereafter, E6LF.
Prepare 5 ml of E6 medium containing 1 μl of Normocin.
Invert several times to mix evenly.
Exclude wells on each edge of the 96-well U-bottom plate during treatment.
Pour 5 ml of prepared E6LF medium into a 10 ml reservoir.
Add 25 μl of E6LF medium per well into the aggregate culture in 96-well U-bottom plates using a multichannel pipette.
Gently tap the plates to mix the medium.
Incubate in the 37°C incubator with 5.0% CO2.
Pour 11 ml of prepared E6 medium containing Normocin into a 10 ml reservoir.
Add 75 μl per well into each well in 96-well U-bottom plates using a multichannel pipette, making the final volume 200 μl per well.
Gently tap the plates to mix the medium.
Incubate in the 37°C incubator with 5.0% CO2.
Make 15 ml of E6 medium containing 30 μl of Normocin and 9 μl of CHIR, mix well by inverting – hereafter, E6-2XCH.
Pour all E6-2XCH medium into a 25 ml reservoir.
Using a multichannel pipette and W-O p200 tips, at about 60° angle, very carefully remove 100 μl of spent medium from each well of 96-well U-bottom plate, leaving 100 μl in each well.
Using a multichannel pipette and regular p200 tips, add 100 μl of fresh E6-2XCH medium into each well, making the final volume of 200 μl and final CHIR concentration of 3 μM.
Gently tap the plates to mix the medium.
Incubate in the 37°C incubator with 5.0% CO2.
Make E6 medium containing 3 μM CHIR (1X) – hereafter, E6-1XCH.
Prepare 15 ml of E6 medium containing 30 μl of Normocin and add 4.5 μl of CHIR.
Invert several times to mix evenly.
Using a multichannel pipette and W-O p200 tips, at about 60° angle, carefully remove 100 μl of spent medium from each well of 96-well U-bottom plate.
Pour all E6-1XCH medium into a 25 ml reservoir.
Using a multichannel pipette and W-O p200 tips, at an angle of 60°, carefully remove spent medium from each well.
Using a multichannel pipette, add 100 μl of fresh E6-1XCH medium per well into the aggregate culture in 96-well U-bottom plates.
Gently tap the plates to mix the medium.
Incubate in the 37°C incubator with 5.0% CO2.
Thaw 630 μl of Matrigel on ice overnight at 4°C.
Place 100 mm petri-dishes on ice.
Remove 630 μl of OM from the mixture.
Add 630 μl of Matrigel to the mixture.
Add 18.9 μl of CHIR to the mixture.
Invert several times to mix evenly.
Keep the mixture on ice.
Using a W-O p1000 tip, collect all aggregates in a 2 ml round bottom tube.
Carefully remove the excessive medium.
Wash aggregates with 1 ml of Advanced DMEM/F12 medium 3 times.
After removing all excessive washing medium, place the tube with aggregates on ice.
Add 1 ml of OM1%M-CH into the tube containing aggregates.
Pour medium (first pour about 15 ml of OM1%M-CH and keep adding as it goes) into cooled petri-dish on ice.
Using a W-O p1000 tip, collect all aggregates that are in 1 ml of OM1%M-CH, and transfer into the OM1%M-CH prepared in petri-dish on ice.
Using a W-O p1000 tip, transfer each aggregate in 500 μl of OM1%M-CH into each well in 24-well low-attachment plates (i.e. one aggregate per well in the total volume of 500 μl per well).
Gently swirl to make sure each well is completely covered by medium and aggregates are not floating on the surface of the medium.
Incubate in the 37°C incubator with 5.0% CO2
Remove 320 μl of OM from a total volume of 32 ml.
Add 320 μl of Matrigel to the remaining OM.
Add 9.6 μl CHIR to the mixture containing OM and Matrigel.
Invert several times to mix evenly and keep on ice.
Remove 250 μl of spent medium from each well of the 24-well plates, leaving 250 μl per well.
Add 250 μl of freshly prepared OM1%M-CH into each well, making a final volume of 500 μl per well.
Gently swirl the plates to mix the medium.
Incubate in the 37°C incubator with 5.0% CO2.
Remove 250 μl of spent medium from each well of the 24-well low-attachment plates, leaving 250 μl per well.
Add 250 μl of freshly prepared OM into each well, making the final volume of 500 μl per well.
Gently swirl the plates to evenly mix the medium.
Incubate in the 37°C incubator with 5.0% CO2.
